name: vibeled RGB V
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one finished premium desktop application icon for vibeled, a USB RGB status-light controller. Asset: a square 1024x1024 app icon for Windows and macOS, genuine RGBA transparent background outside the icon. Design: a centered midnight-navy rounded-square tile occupying about 81% of the canvas width, with generous perfectly transparent margins on all four sides, subtle refined bevel, smooth rounded corners. Inside the tile, one large unmistakable bold rounded V formed from two thick connected luminous glass LED light guides, broad enough to read instantly at 16px and 32px. The V is the sole symbol: no small details. A rich red/coral glow at the upper-left endpoint flows into warm amber then vibrant green near the rounded bottom vertex; the right arm flows from green into electric cyan and deep blue at the upper-right endpoint. The shape is coherent, beautifully balanced and geometric, with softly rounded caps and joint, a bright but controlled inner light, tasteful 3D depth and restrained reflections. Very high contrast against the dark tile. Symmetric silhouette, front view, no perspective tilt. Modern crafted macOS utility icon quality, calm precision, clean legible silhouette, restrained light spill contained within the tile. No lettering, no wordmark, no text, no cable, no USB trident, no circuitry, no sparkles, no separate dots, no scenery, no white background, no checkerboard texture. Produce exactly one centered icon, not a presentation sheet, not a mockup, not multiple variants. Preserve genuine transparent alpha around the rounded tile.
